integrity: The formulas are proved algebraically; bounded computations are illustrative, not a formal proof or an external attestation.
scientific_limitations: Only squarefree characteristic polynomials and rank-one nonzero frequencies. The normalized profile depends on rational roots; unnormalized coefficients also require the fibre size S. Recovery of roots from rank-one coefficients uses S. Other orbital Fourier literature may imply this specialization.
title: Normalized rank-one Fourier coefficients and rational roots of squarefree matrix characteristic polynomials
